capabilities.summary: No reseller, subaccount, tenant, or parent-child account operations are published.
Service contacts exist, but there is no general end-customer identity or organization model.
iFax Enterprise has fax-only users and DID permissions; no account-wide RBAC is published.
Inventory is implicitly scoped to the authenticated account and exposes no tenant owner identifier or cross-account transfer.
The contract defines HTTP Basic authentication plus one Security-Key, with no token, scope, service-account, or credential-lifecycle API.
No brand, theme, domain, email-template, or customer-facing portal configuration is published.
The authenticated account can read service, country, Zone 2, and international toll-free rates.
No customer catalog, price book, markup, margin, discount, or quote API is published.
No invoice, line-item, taxation, exemption, refund, or credit-note API is published; 10DLC tax_number is regulatory identity data only.
Balance and allowed credit are readable, but no credit ledger, adjustment, allocation, or customer-credit API is published.
The current provider account can be refilled and its payment-method type read; payment-method CRUD and customer payment flows are absent.
Voice, fax, and SMS activity are available, but no rated usage ledger or invoice linkage is published.
Inventory and messaging callbacks exist, but billing, account, hierarchy, and credential events do not; authentication and retry semantics are unspecified.
No ticket, case, note, SLA, or help-desk operation is published.
The public contract publishes production endpoints only and no sandbox or test-account lifecycle.

provider_questions.question: Is there a reseller or subaccount API outside the public 2.3.2 contract, and what identifiers and lifecycle states does it expose?
Can inventory be assigned or transferred between subaccounts without delete/reorder operations?
Can each subaccount receive scoped, revocable credentials or tokens with read/write and product-level permissions?
Are there account-wide users, roles, SSO, MFA, or delegated-administrator APIs beyond iFax Enterprise permissions?
Are portal branding, custom domain, email/SMS template, and legal-document settings available by API?
Can resellers create customer price books, markups, discounts, quotes, or committed-rate plans through an API?
Are rated line items, invoices, tax calculations, exemptions, refunds, and credit notes available by API or export?
Are tokenized payment methods, ACH mandates, payment intents, receipts, failures, and chargebacks available without handling card data?
Which timestamps, IDs, rates, surcharges, taxes, and adjustments form the authoritative billable usage ledger?
Are account, billing, payment, inventory, and credential events available, and what are their signature, retry, ordering, and deduplication contracts?
Can QuestBlue provision a non-production reseller hierarchy with non-billable fixtures and reversible lifecycle operations?
Is there a partner support or escalation API with customer-safe case identifiers and status events?
